name: Budapest
tagline: Europe's Best-Kept Secret for Affordable Luxury Retirement
description: Budapest delivers a grand European capital experience at Eastern European prices, making it one of the continent's most compelling FIRE destinations. Thermal baths, ruin bars, Art Nouveau architecture, and a booming food scene come at 40-60% less than Western Europe. Hungary's residency-by-investment options and low cost of living stretch your FIRE portfolio remarkably far.

quickFacts.visa: Residency Bond Program or Guest Investor Visa for non-EU citizens. EU citizens have freedom of movement. White Card (long-term residence) available after 5 years.
quickFacts.internetSpeed: 100-500 Mbps fiber widely available, excellent 5G coverage
quickFacts.safetyRating: Safe — low violent crime, standard pickpocket awareness in tourist zones
quickFacts.nearestAirport: Budapest Ferenc Liszt International Airport (BUD) — 30 min from city center
quickFacts.climate: Continental with cold winters (-2 to 5°C) and warm summers (22-30°C). Distinct four seasons with beautiful spring and autumn.

housing.description: Compact furnished studio in an affordable, well-connected outer-central district (outer VII/VIII/IX, XIII fringe, XI/XIV)

dining.description: Occasional casual meals at unpretentious neighbourhood eateries and étkezde-style spots

healthcare.description: Entry-level private cover that satisfies the residence-permit requirement

transportation.description: Unlimited BKK monthly pass (8,950 HUF) across the full metro/tram/bus network

entertainment.description: Budget gym plus the city's abundant low-cost culture (thermal baths, cinema, ruin bars)

1M.lifestyle: Lean Budapest buys a compact, comfortable base in a walkable district where the tram and metro make a car pointless. Days lean on the city's cheapest luxuries — thermal-bath soaks, riverside walks, a coffee-and-book afternoon, and the odd ruin-bar evening. Groceries come from discount chains and the great market halls, with meals out kept to friendly neighbourhood tables. It is a frugal but dignified pace in one of Europe's most livable capitals, with Hungarian a real barrier outside the central English-workable core.

housing.description: Decent furnished studio or small 1BR in a nicer central district (VI/VII)

dining.description: Dining out a few times weekly at solid mid-range restaurants

healthcare.description: Standard private plan with lower deductible and broader outpatient access

transportation.description: BKK pass plus regular Bolt/taxi hops

entertainment.description: Quality gym membership plus regular concerts, cinema, and thermal-spa days

2M.lifestyle: The Comfortable+ tier moves into a nicer central address within easy reach of the Danube and the café districts. Eating out becomes a regular pleasure rather than a treat, and the grocery basket makes room for good coffee, wine, and imported extras. A proper gym membership and a steady rhythm of concerts, cinema, and spa days fill the calendar. Quick taxi rides supplement the transit pass whenever convenience wins.

housing.description: Well-finished 1BR in a prime-adjacent central district (V/VI/VII core, Újlipótváros, or I/II Buda)

dining.description: Regular quality dining with occasional fine-dining evenings

healthcare.description: Comprehensive private plan with private-clinic (Medicover-style) access

transportation.description: Transit pass plus frequent taxis/Bolt across the week

entertainment.description: Premium gym plus a rich, regular cultural calendar (opera, concerts, galleries, spa)

3M.lifestyle: FIRE-level Budapest settles into a handsome, well-finished apartment in one of the most sought-after central districts — a short walk from the opera, the Basilica, or the Buda embankments. Dining out is a genuine highlight, ranging from beloved bistros to the occasional tasting menu, and the pantry is stocked with quality produce and good wine. Culture is a habit here: opera nights, concerts, gallery openings, and regular spa afternoons. Comprehensive private cover unlocks fast, English-speaking clinic care without a second thought.

housing.description: High-spec prime-central 1BR or small 2BR (V Belváros, Andrássy/VI), or a Buda-hills apartment

dining.description: Frequent fine dining across the city's leading restaurants

healthcare.description: Premium private plan plus private-clinic membership (Medicover/Rózsakert)

transportation.description: Private car (fuel, insurance, city parking) alongside taxis

entertainment.description: Premium wellness/spa membership plus a full cultural and social season

luxuryExtras.description: Club membership, fine Tokaji wine, VIP spa access, and a travel fund

5M.lifestyle: Premium living claims a high-spec address at a prime-central corner or up in the leafy Buda hills, with a car in the garage for weekend escapes to the Danube Bend or Lake Balaton. The table turns toward the city's best kitchens, and the wine at home leans to good Tokaji and Villány labels. A weekly cleaner keeps the flat effortless, while club memberships, VIP spa access, and a standing travel fund round out an unmistakably comfortable rhythm. Private care is top-tier, with concierge-style clinic membership on call.

housing.description: Luxury 1–2BR at a prime address or a Buda-hills residence

dining.description: Constant fine dining at the city's very best tables

healthcare.description: Premium international concierge medicine with global evacuation cover

transportation.description: Premium car with chauffeur/on-demand rides as desired

entertainment.description: Uncapped culture — opera boxes, events, hobbies, and private spa access

luxuryExtras.description: Concierge, fine Tokaji wine, VIP spa, and a generous travel fund

10M.lifestyle: FatFIRE in Budapest means a luxury residence at a marquee central address or a villa-style apartment in the Buda hills, with a premium car and chauffeur on call. Dining is at the city's very best tables as a matter of routine, with a good cellar at home. Regular housekeeping, concierge service, and VIP thermal-spa access make daily life frictionless, while a generous travel fund keeps the rest of Europe within easy reach. Premium international concierge medicine ensures care anywhere. This is the ceiling of what local luxury buys in one of Europe's grand capitals — comfortably below a Western-European equivalent.
